Make the camera light blink when a call or message comes in (she never silences her phone), make everything she plays come through fully in one ear whether it's the speaker or any headphones, and show the words that are spoken, plus other sounds, as text on videos that include it. I see you just scrolled down to the Hearing section. That's where we are for the subtitles, but we need to start with the speaker settings first. Please scroll back up and tap on **Audio & Visual**, which is just below Sound Recognition.

I see you are on the Subtitles screen. Good work getting there. Please turn on the switch next to 'Closed Captions + SDH'. After you do that, we will customize the style to make the text bigger and easier to read.

Ah, got it. Switching that now.
Good, you disabled the transcriptions. Now, please turn ON the switch next to 'Closed Captions + SDH' so she gets the visual text on videos.
Perfect, Closed Captions are on. Now let's make sure the text is big and readable. Please tap on the 'Style' row to customize it.
Great, the transcriptions are off. Now let's go back up one level and tap on 'Audio & Visual' to fix the sound settings.

From the iPhone User Guide — “Flash the iPhone indicator light for notifications”:

The indicator light is the light-emitting diode (LED) located on the back of iPhone, next to the camera lens.

1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Audio & Visual, then turn on LED Flash for Alerts.
2. Turn any of the following on or off: Flash While Unlocked: The indicator light flashes even when iPhone is unlocked. Flash in Silent Mode: The indicator light flashes even when iPhone is in Silent mode .

You can use mono audio, adjust left-right stereo balance, and—with supported headphones—amplify soft sounds and adjust certain frequencies to best suit your hearing needs.

2. Adjust any of the following: Mono Audio: Turn on Mono Audio to make the left and right speakers play the same content. Stereo Audio Balance: Drag the Balance slider left or right.

Use phone noise cancellation

Phone noise cancellation is available and on by default on iPhone 12 and earlier, and can be turned off for your comfort.

1. Go to Settings > Accessibility > Audio & Visual.
2. Turn Phone Noise Cancellation off or on.

*[image: An iPhone showing an example of subtitles with a custom style.]*

2. If you prefer closed captioning or subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing when available, turn on Closed Captions + SDH.
